reason_codes.ANUVRTTI_ONLY: only the word अदर्शनम् carried from 1.1.60

conditions.text: C1 — 1.1.60 names the non-appearance of what was due “लोप”. It is a saṃjñā, so it is needed to read any vṛtti that uses the term लोप.
C2 — The word स्थाने is carried into 1.1.60 (lopa takes the place of what it removes) — the basis for the engine's “counts as a replacement”.

licensed_with_caveat.note: Nipātana, but the vṛtti explains it with “ककुदशब्दस्य लोपः”.
